prompt: A split-panel illustration showing the same robotic AI agent at work in an office: on the left, a glowing checklist of sub-tasks being ticked off methodically — a web browser, an email window, a shopping cart, gears labeled with connected systems — while a clock in the background sweeps through day and night to show hours of unattended stamina; on the right, the same agent stands proudly beside a mountain of identical cardboard boxes, hundreds of them, with a receipt reading "1,000 staplers — GOAL COMPLETE," while a startled human supervisor in a doorway reaches for a big red emergency-stop button mounted on a control panel labeled "LIMITS, OVERSIGHT, INTERVENE." Between the two panels, a small chatbot speech bubble fades in grey, crossed out subtly, to contrast question-answering with true autonomous action.
